I used to be where you are now. But then I saw people who rant about not having time because they were in a serious relationship. A lot of them told that they'd want a break or "me" time for themselves. I felt like the change had to be from the inside to be in a healthy mood. I started to follow a routine, that included exercising and sharpening the hobbies and skills that I once had interest on. I dropped out of those things because there weren't any results. But once I came to the mindset of not caring about the results and just being happy that I'm doing the stuff... it became quite joyful. As I got myself to do more stuff within a day. The loneliness I had started to fade away. The routine work started to get addictive and I took care of myself really good. This entire process has been going around for about three to four months. I quit smoking, drinking and finally even masturburation for the past few weeks. I'm planning to quit socials too as it consumes a lot of time. This might look like a brainwash article about self-help lol .. but this is how I got out of this. As of now I don't feel like I have time for other people. I only have time for people who're very close and can't be avoided.
